Title: Base configuration
Description: Root directory for generated results. Relative paths are resolved from the launch directory.

Title: Base configuration
Description: Generate individual sample analyses and reports for every row in Samples/samples.csv.

Title: Base configuration
Description: Cluster all samples in Samples/samples.csv into one population catalogue and generate an Atlas report.

Title: Base configuration
Description: Analyze the explicit pairs in Samples/comparison.csv, including their individual processing and rescue evidence.

Title: Base configuration
Description: Restrict analysis and coverage normalization to the target intervals supplied in Adaptivesamplingbed.

Title: Base configuration
Description: Target BED in the selected assembly, required when Adaptivesampling is true. Chromosome aliases are translated; coordinates are unchanged.

Title: Base configuration
Description: Select T2T-CHM13v2.0 (true) or GRCh38/hg38 (false). Selects chromosome validation, gene annotation and tandem-repeat tracks; does not lift coordinates between assemblies.

Title: Base configuration
Description: Random seed for reproducible Atlas catalogue vector permutations.

Title: Base configuration
Description: After a successful complete run, retain only final HTML reports in pipeline-owned result folders. Remove intermediate evidence, RDS, VCF/TSV exports and analysis logs. Shared reference downloads and original inputs are retained. If false or omitted, only generated CRAM-to-BAM files and indexes are removed at completion. Partial or failed runs are not cleaned.

Title: Base configuration
Description: Minimum supporting reads for regional rescue calls in Compare and Atlas.

Title: Base configuration
Description: Minimum ALT-read support for primary variant calling and reportable events.

Title: Base configuration
Description: Minimum insertion length, in base pairs. In the base configuration it also controls downstream primary filtering; Hitsv can use its separate candidate threshold.

Title: Base configuration
Description: Distance in base pairs used when merging caller loci into HitSV windows.

Title: Base configuration
Description: Absolute minimum coverage for callability. Zero disables the absolute cutoff, but positive coverage is still required.

Title: Base configuration
Description: Maximum regional depth divided by its normalization baseline; larger ratios are marked non-callable.
